calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) AS earliest_sale,
  MAX(sale_date) AS latest_sale
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  'Gross sales' AS description,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-09-28'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-10-04'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Returns' AS description,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND r.return_date >= '2026-09-28'
  AND r.return_date <= '2026-10-04'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Net sales' AS description,
  (SELECT SUM(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f 
   INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
   WHERE p.sku = 101624 AND f.sale_date >= '2026-09-28' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-10-04')
  -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) FROM fact_return_line r
   INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
   WHERE p.sku = 101624 AND r.return_date >= '2026-09-28' AND r.return_date <= '2026-10-04') AS units
